no-activity.label: WORKSHOP ENTRY
no-activity.title: No active workshops
no-activity.body: Ask your organizer for an activity link.

ended.label: ACTIVITY CLOSED
ended.title: This workshop has ended
ended.body: Contact your organizer to join another workshop.
ended.detail: Files from this workshop may no longer be available.

not-ready.label: SERVICE UNAVAILABLE
not-ready.title: Your environment is not ready
not-ready.body: Wait a moment, then try again.
not-ready.detail: Still unavailable? Send your activity and learner ID to your organizer.

denied.label: ACCESS UNAVAILABLE
denied.title: Access unavailable
denied.body: Open the services linked from your own workshop.

expired.label: SESSION EXPIRED
expired.title: Sign in to continue
expired.detail: Check your notebook’s last result before rerunning a cell.

signed-out.label: ENTRY SIGN-OUT
signed-out.title: Signed out of this entry
signed-out.body: Close other course and service tabs.
signed-out.detail: Other tabs may still be signed in.

help.label: ACCOUNT HELP
help.title: Contact your organizer
help.body: Ask for a workshop account or a new temporary password.

login-error.title: Sign in
login-error.error: Incorrect username or password. Try again.
